standards.IEC 60825-1: safety of laser products — classification, MPE tables (edition used for the formulae: 2014+A11:2021; verify the current one)
standards.IEC 60825-4: laser guards — the exposure classes T1/T2/T3 and the guard's protective exposure limit (verify the current edition)
standards.ISO 11553-1: laser processing machines — general safety requirements (verify the current edition)
standards.EN 12254: screens for laser working places — protection levels AB1–AB10 per power density, wavelength and test time (verify the current edition)
standards.EN 207: eye protectors — scale numbers LB1–LB10 (D mode: continuous wave) (cited for the OD ladder only; verify the current edition)

diode_eff.basis: 976 nm pump diodes' electrical-to-optical efficiency (class of today's modules)

optical_eff.basis: pump-to-signal conversion of a Yb MOPA including combiners and splices (Svarog's 1 kW stage: 0.93 on the launched pump × its combiner 0.95 × ~0.85 of the chain)

aux_W.basis: controls, fans, pumps and the diode's thermo-electric coolers where fitted

cooling_COP.basis: a compressor chiller's coefficient of performance at 20 °C water, 35 °C air

delivery_loss_dB.basis: the process fibre and its connectors (Svarog: 0.3 dB on 20 m)

lens_absorption.basis: each of the head's two lenses (coated fused silica at 1 µm)

abs_keyhole_steel.basis: keyhole absorptivity of mild steel at 1 µm (multiple reflections; svarog_industrial.WELD_MATERIALS)

abs_keyhole_al.basis: keyhole absorptivity of aluminium at 1 µm

melting_eff.basis: the share of the absorbed energy that ends in the melt (Swift-Hook & Gick's bound 0.48)

workpiece_reflectivity.basis: a specular reflection off a flat, polished or molten workpiece at 1 µm (steel 0.6, aluminium 0.9)

seam_gap_mm.basis: a seam or gap between barrier panels the beam can pass through

wood_piloted_flux.basis: critical absorbed flux for the piloted ignition of wood (fire-safety handbooks: 10–13 kW/m²)

wood_spontaneous_flux.basis: critical flux for the unpiloted ignition of wood

pc_degraded_transmission_x.basis: how much a scratched, crazed or thinned certified sheet's transmission grows (no product data: a sensitivity)

meta.rule: PASS needs certified protection evidence; a simulation bound gives INCOMPLETE; distance alone never establishes safety

source_capex_EUR.basis: no maker publishes a price; low = a used YLR-2000-SM listed at 19,999 USD (eBay, user-reported); nominal = 2 × a buyer's-guide estimate of 20–35 kUSD for a 1 kW IPG/Raycus module (mid, unverified); high = the reported original new price of a 2014 YLS-2000 (100 kUSD, laserresale, user-reported)

source_capex_per_kW_EUR.basis: the 2 kW range per kW, applied to the 3 kW source

head_EUR.basis: Raytools BF03S 3 kW wobble head 1,263 USD; Chinese 1.5–3 kW wobble heads 4,070–5,810 USD; Raytools BF06K 6 kW 5,122 USD (retail listings)

chiller_EUR.basis: S&A 2 kW chiller 1,259 USD; a 15 kW industrial chiller 4,200 USD; a 5 kW laser chiller sits between (no listing with a price found)

electricity_EUR_per_kWh.basis: Eurostat non-household 500–2000 MWh/yr, H2 2025: EU average 18.37, Finland 7.48, Ireland 25.52 EUR/100 kWh

labour_EUR_per_h.basis: Eurostat 2025 average hourly labour cost: EU 34.9, Bulgaria 12.0, Luxembourg 56.8 (economy-wide, not a welder's rate)

argon_EUR_per_m3.basis: US cylinder refills 40–60 USD per 125 cf (≈ 45–60 USD/m³); bulk is far cheaper (730 USD/t ≈ 1.3 USD/m³)

argon_flow_l_per_min.basis: shielding-gas flow of a sheet weld (assumed: welding practice)

maintenance_pct_of_capex_per_year.basis: assumed: no published figure found; the usual service-contract range for industrial lasers

diode_life_h.basis: passively cooled bars ~20,000 h to 80 % power; 9xx nm pump modules > 30,000 h median at 90 % confidence; 100,000 h is the makers' marketing claim

diode_share_of_capex.basis: assumed: the pump modules' share of a fibre laser's cost

steel_sheet_EUR_per_t.basis: NW Europe HRC 731 EUR/t EXW (SMM, Oct 2026); sheet cut to size carries 20–50 % over coil (assumed premium)

aluminium_sheet_EUR_per_kg.basis: assumed: LME ingot ~2.5 EUR/kg plus a rolled-sheet premium; no 5754 sheet listing found

black_pc_EUR_per_m2_per_mm.basis: assumed: standard black polycarbonate sheet ~40–80 EUR/m² at 5 mm; no listing found

certified_sheet_EUR_per_m2.basis: 1064 nm laser-safety acrylic sheet (OD 6+): 2,200–2,800 USD/m² from 12×12 in windows, 2,450–4,900 USD/m² per-sq-in pricing (retail; EN 12254-certified polycarbonate not found with a price)
